The remaining 35 findings concern Markdown syntax, documented credentials, official service links, product identifiers, or readable Chinese text. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or encoded payloads in the supplied files; external package behavior was not audited.

content.user_title: Analyze Product Reviews with Traceable Evidence
content.value_statement: Product reviews mix useful feedback with conflicting experiences and incomplete context. This skill groups review themes, cites source evidence, and prioritizes improvements within the available sample.
actual_capabilities: Analyze supplied review text or readable tables without requiring an API key or online retrieval.
Retrieve Xiaohongshu product details, reviews, and selected reply threads through documented CLI commands or corresponding MCP tools.
Group positive, negative, and mixed feedback into themes with record counts and explicit denominators.
Preserve source row numbers or review identifiers, cite short quotations, and redact unrelated personal information.
Distinguish review bodies from replies, document duplicate handling, and disclose pagination gaps and sample bias.
Provide up to three evidence-linked priorities for product verification, description changes, or customer service guidance.
limitations: Online retrieval supports Xiaohongshu products and requires SocialDataX credentials; the direct CLI also requires Node.js/npm.
Online analysis starts with one review page; additional pages require returned continuation tokens and may incur provider charges.
Findings describe the analyzed sample, not verified defects, storewide complaint rates, or all purchasers.
External CLI behavior is not included in the supplied files; examples execute an unpinned npm package.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Product Investigations
use_cases.description: Identify recurring quality and usability themes, compare conflicting experiences, and select up to three evidence-backed investigations.

use_cases.title: Clarify Purchase Expectations
use_cases.description: Review supplied feedback for specification confusion, packaging concerns, and service questions before revising product descriptions.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Traceable Review Study
use_cases.description: Analyze a defined Xiaohongshu sample with consistent filters, source identifiers, transparent counts, and clearly stated coverage gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Supplied Reviews
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these product reviews: [review text]. Group strengths and concerns by theme. Cite original row numbers and do not use online retrieval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand a small pasted review sample.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Review Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [review file] for [product]. Explain duplicate handling, count themes by review record, redact personal details, and recommend three evidence-backed priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: evaluate an existing review table.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect an Online Product Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [Xiaohongshu product link] to retrieve one review page. Confirm dependency execution approval first. Report sorting, sample size, quoted evidence, and coverage limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: retrieve reviews with configured SocialDataX access.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Matched Review Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [SKU A] and [SKU B] with identical sorting and filters, up to two pages each. Separate replies, document gaps, and avoid population claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare bounded product samples using consistent analysis rules.

output_examples.input: Illustrative input: three rows say 'Fits well', 'Seam opened immediately', and 'Fits well, but the seam loosened'.
output: Sample: three supplied reviews; no dates or verified purchase status provided.
Fit: positive mentions in 2 of 3 reviews. Evidence: 'Fits well' in rows 1 and 3.
Seam durability: negative mentions in 2 of 3 reviews. Evidence: 'Seam opened immediately' in row 2.
Priority: investigate seam durability. These statements do not establish a verified defect or a storewide failure rate.

output_examples.input: Illustrative input: four review records were retrieved; continuation failed with a nonempty token, and one selected review has two replies.
output: Coverage: four review bodies and two replies retrieved; the sample is incomplete because continuation failed.
Counting: replies remain separate and do not increase the four-review denominator.
Recovery: retain retrieved records and resume using the returned token within the original limits after resolving the error.
Evidence limit: no theme conclusions are available in this illustration because review text was not supplied.

best_practices: Define the product, sample limits, sorting, and filters before retrieval or comparison.
Preserve source identifiers, cite short quotations, and remove unrelated personal information.
Keep API keys in environment configuration and approve a reviewed, pinned CLI version before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not describe sample theme frequencies as storewide complaint, return, or defect rates.
Do not merge replies into review counts or delete matching text as proven duplicate reviews without supporting identifiers.
Do not fabricate missing fields, evidence, or coverage, and do not run dependency installation without authorization.

faq.question: Do I need an API key for supplied reviews?
faq.answer: No. Supplied text and readable tables can be analyzed directly without online retrieval or a SocialDataX API key.

faq.question: Which platforms support online retrieval?
faq.answer: The documented online workflow supports Xiaohongshu product links and SKU identifiers. Reviews from other platforms must be supplied as text or readable tables.

faq.question: What does online retrieval require?
faq.answer: SocialDataX online access requires SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY. The direct CLI also requires Node.js/npm, execution approval, and sufficient provider balance.

faq.question: Does the skill retrieve every review?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves one page by default. Additional pages depend on returned continuation tokens, agreed sample limits, and successful provider responses.

faq.question: How are counts and quotations handled?
faq.answer: Themes count review records once per theme, with explicit denominators. Quotations retain row numbers or review IDs, and replies remain separate.

faq.question: Can it contact buyers or manage orders?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, contacting buyers, posting reviews, refunds, and account operations.
